multiCollglm

Collinearity diagnostics for generalized linear models (GLMs), on glm objects or on regularized models fitted with glmnet / cv.glmnet.

condition_number(), bkw_diagnostics() and rvif_diagnostics() generalize the classical linear-regression collinearity diagnostics to any family and link function. By default (method = "WS", Weissfeld and Sereika, 1991) they are computed on the design matrix weighted by the IRLS weights at convergence and scaled to unit length by column, without centering, so the intercept takes part in the diagnosis. The method argument also gives the definition of MacKinnon and Puterman ("MP"), the one of the original design matrix \(X'X\), unweighted ("X"), and the raw information matrix \(X'WX\) ("RAW"). ml_collinearity() adds a fourth, complementary diagnostic, comparing the condition number of the original design matrix against that of the IRLS-weighted information matrix (Lesaffre and Marx, 1993) to tell apart ordinary collinearity among the explanatory variables from ML-collinearity.

Installation 

install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("cbgarciaugr/multiCollglm")
# or, from a local copy of the package folder:
# remotes::install_local("path/to/multiCollglm_0.4.0")

Quick example 

library(multiCollglm)

mod <- glm(y ~ x1 + x2 + x3 + x4, family = Gamma(link = "inverse"), data = data)

condition_number(mod)                  # Weissfeld and Sereika (default)
condition_number(mod, method = "MP")   # MacKinnon and Puterman
condition_number(mod, method = "X")    # original design matrix X'X (unit length)
condition_number(mod, method = "RAW")  # X'WX, no transformation
bkw_diagnostics(mod)
rvif_diagnostics(mod)
ml_collinearity(mod)

Learn more

vignette("multiCollglm") is the package’s complete guide: every function, the four condition-number definitions available via method, the glmnet/cv.glmnet interface, and the full ML-collinearity rationale.

The package website also has the full function reference an article comparing the package with VisCollin and a series of reproduction articles: real published cases reproduced with multiCollglm, using four example datasets bundled with the package (LeeCancer, Nitrogen, Mine, Plastic) and a fifth (Bodyfat, from the TH.data package).
